references.text: The context of this verse describes how leprosy in garments and fabrics is to be identified and assessed by the priest.
Continuation of the laws concerning leprosy in garments, including further instructions on burning infected items.
Parallel laws regarding unclean objects that must be destroyed or cleansed, including clothing and leather articles.
Similar instruction on destruction by fire concerning leprosy in houses—parallel to the burning of infected garments.
Command to burn unclean things with fire, especially idols, demonstrating the same principle of cleansing through fire.
The sin offering was to be burned outside the camp, reflecting the same principle of destroying what is unclean by fire.
Instructions to burn the sin offering outside the camp show the same pattern for handling anything associated with sin and uncleanness.
